text: On a stone block at the water’s edge stood something Gus knew better than his own face.
A lamp. Brass, lens, wick. A keeper’s lamp, smaller and older than his own.
He laid his hand on the glass.
Somebody had lit this lamp tonight, while the real one was dark.
And its lens was not pointed at the sky. It faced a crack in the rock, a slit that opened onto the sea…
